newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian banks rush to buy rollover T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Romanian banks rush to buy rollover T-bills.

text.p: Romanian banks, operating on an overliquid money market, crowded to buy rollover treasury bills, traders said on Thursday.
The Finance Ministry's offer of 183.8 billion lei ($32.75 million) was oversubscribed with 10 banks entering bids totalling 200.3 billion, latest central bank data showed.
The T-bills, which mature on May 8, offer an annual yield calculated as an average of the weekly auctioned credit rates during their life period.

Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni, Banca Bucuresti, Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare, Banca Comerciala Romana, Banca Turco-Romana , Eximbank, Banca Albina, Banca Internationala a Religiilor and the Romanian subsidiaries of Citibank and ABN Amro have bought the bills.
The money market stayed cash-heavy on Thursday with operators bracing for rises in short-term prices following the rise in the central bank's one-week refinancing rate to 70 percent from 65 percent.
